diagnosis: The carried-position acquisition correctly retained post-roster transaction history, but the evaluator required a future open even after a former member reached its last verified positive-activity bar. That organizer-owned liquidation shortfall paused the first point.
remediation: For a carried former member only, when its current bar is the last verified positive-activity transaction bar and the next boundary has no transaction open, force-settle the residual at the current close with ordinary costs and no participation cap. Current weekly members still require the frozen unavailability audit; membership, targets, data, scoring, and candidate bundles are unchanged.
resume_policy: Use the existing organizer-failure resume record for the already-started point; do not retry, replace, or restart any candidate terminal.
